body.summary: At Lumon Industries, employees in the windowless Macrodata Refinement department have undergone severance, a surgical split that gives them a work self (innie) with no memory of the outside and an outside self (outie) with no memory of the job. Mark Scout, a widower who severed to escape grief over his wife Gemma, leads MDR alongside Irving, Dylan and new hire Helly R., who fights the arrangement from her first day. The team discovers other departments, a break room used for coerced apologies, and the overtime contingency that can wake innies off-site; they trigger it to see the outside world. ||Mark learns Gemma may be alive inside Lumon, reintegrates with the help of ex-Lumon surgeon Reghabi, and learns MDR's numbers are a doorway into Gemma's mind: each completed file builds her a new innie. On the day he finishes Cold Harbor, he frees Gemma to the exit stairwell but chooses to stay on the severed floor with Helly.||

notable_scenes.summary: Helly wakes on the conference table and is given the five-question survey, answering 'unknown' to nearly everything.
Helly hangs herself in the elevator; Mark finds her and the outie refuses to resign.
notable_scenes.locator: S01E05 The Grim Barbarity Of Optics and Design

notable_scenes.summary: Dylan bites Milchick during the Music Dance Experience after learning of the overtime contingency.
The innies wake in the outside world; Helly reveals herself at the gala and shouts that they are prisoners.
Irving accuses Helly of being an outie and tries to drown her; Milchick removes the Glasgow block.
Cobel tells Mark the numbers are a doorway into Gemma's mind and that each file builds her a new innie.
Mark frees Gemma to the stairwell, then turns back to find Helly.
